# Tadele Teen Talks

> A teen-run news and media platform sharing unfiltered stories, ideas, and
> opinions from young voices, ages 13-21. Run by two co-CEOs, Ije Ezedani and
> Liya Tadele, with a team of teen contributors across writing, video, art and
> social media.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tadeleteentalk.pages.dev/): Latest articles, videos, artwork and photo essays
- [Articles](https://tadeleteentalk.pages.dev/category.html?cat=articles): Written stories and opinion pieces
- [Videos](https://tadeleteentalk.pages.dev/category.html?cat=videos): Video stories and interviews
- [Artwork](https://tadeleteentalk.pages.dev/category.html?cat=artwork): Photography and illustration
- [Magazines](https://tadeleteentalk.pages.dev/category.html?cat=magazines): Collected issues

## Notes

- Individual stories live at /article.html?post=<slug>
- /admin, /editor and /login are staff-only and are excluded in robots.txt
